card.line: Babylon was a great city on the Euphrates and the capital of Nebuchadnezzar's empire, where God's people lived in exile after Jerusalem fell.

moments.title: Jehoiachin Taken Captive
moments.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon besieged Jerusalem, and King Jehoiachin surrendered. Nebuchadnezzar took him, the royal family, and the leading men into exile in Babylon.

moments.title: Zedekiah Taken to Babylon
moments.text: After Zedekiah rebelled, Nebuchadnezzar marched against Jerusalem again. The Chaldeans seized Zedekiah, judged him at Riblah, and took him to Babylon in shackles.

moments.title: A Letter to the Exiles
moments.text: Jeremiah sent a letter to the exiles in Babylon with a message from the LORD. He promised that when Babylon's seventy years were complete, He would restore them to their home.

moments.title: Daniel Saves the Wise Men
moments.text: The king was so angry that he ordered all the wise men of Babylon destroyed. Daniel answered with tact, asked his friends to plead for God's mercy, and asked Arioch to spare the wise men.

moments.title: The Golden Statue
moments.text: Nebuchadnezzar set up a golden statue in the province of Babylon. Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who managed the province, were accused of refusing to worship it.
